description: Vertical 1080x1920 3D dark scene. Center-frame at 45% height: 4-node binary tree of glowing fg-white spheres (root 10 center, left 5, right 15, 7 as right-child of 5) connected by muted-grey cylinders, viewed side-on filling 65% width on frame 0. No UI in top 10% or bottom 25%. Camera starts side-on then orbits upward to directly overhead. Hidden lower spheres fade to muted transparent as overhead view locks.

beats.action: Full side-on 3D tree pops bright in center, fg-white spheres with muted-grey edges
Camera starts slow orbit right, tree rotates showing depth and branching
Camera rises overhead, three vertical accent-cyan dashed sight-lines drop from top onto tree
Lower occluded sphere 7 dims to muted grey and shrinks behind root 10
Only top skyline spheres stay accent-cyan bright, hidden nodes fade to 15% opacity overhead view

description: Vertical 1080x1920 3D dark scene, new shot: tight side view. Same 4-sphere tree centered at 50% height viewed perfectly side-on, spheres labeled 10,5,15. Three vertical accent-cyan sight-beams fall from above. Horizontal axis at bottom-center shows sideways spots in muted-grey. Kept highest nodes glow accent-cyan, occluded duplicates pulse accent2-magenta then dim.

beats.action: Side-on tree appears center, top-down arrow in accent-cyan drops from above
Three vertical accent-cyan sight-beams extend down through tree, illuminating columns
Camera pushes to side profile, branches align showing overlap in depth
Nodes 10 and 7 in same central beam pulse accent2-magenta together
Beam highlights stacking: 7 slides behind 10, 10 stays solid fg-white, 7 turns transparent
Highest sphere in each beam locks accent-cyan glow, lower duplicates dim to muted
Top spheres lift slightly upward along beams, casting accent glow
Bottom sideways axis lights left-to-right, three spots mark kept columns

description:
Vertical 1080x1920 2D Manim diagram on dark background. Center 40-65% height: clean binary tree graph with white circles labeled 10 (root top), 5 left, 15 right, 7 right-child of 5, muted-grey edges. Below tree at 68%: horizontal HD number line with -1, 0, +1 in muted-grey, active HD turns accent3-yellow. Bottom-center 72%: horizontal BFS queue bar of rounded rectangles. First-seen HD slots lock accent-cyan, duplicates flash accent2-magenta then fade. Focal node each beat scales up accent-cyan.

Viewer feedback for this new version (follow it): there are a lot of overlapping components scale the video accordingly cahnge the components if needed make the animation simpler

beats.action: Tree builds top-down in center, root 10 scales in accent-cyan with HD 0 label accent3-yellow below it
Left child 5 pops in, edge draws, HD -1 label lights accent3-yellow under it
Right child 15 pops in, edge draws, HD +1 label lights accent3-yellow
BFS queue bar appears bottom-center with [10,5,15], 10 dequeues and turns accent-cyan
Level 1 highlights: 5 and 15 lift and turn accent-cyan, queue advances level-by-level left-to-right
Map row of HD slots appears: -1:5 locks good-green, 0:10 locks good-green, +1:15 locks good-green
Node 7 pops as right-child of 5, queue shows 7 current in accent-cyan
Dashed accent2-magenta line drops from 7 to HD 0 slot showing collision on zero
Node 7 flashes accent2-magenta, shrinks and fades to muted-grey with X, HD 0 stays 10
Rule banner flashes: first-seen HD boxes glow accent-cyan, final kept set 5,10,15 pulses together

description: Vertical 1080x1920 3D dark scene rhyming hook. Starts overhead close on dimmed full tree center at 50%, then pulls back and tilts to side angle matching Scene 0 frame 0. Foreground at 60% height: clean skyline row of three bright accent-cyan spheres labeled 5,10,15 left-to-right with muted-grey connecting baseline. Background tree fades muted-grey except kept nodes. Floating accent3-yellow O(N) badge center at 40% appears briefly. Final frame: same side-on tree as hook frame 0 but only skyline nodes bright.

beats.action: Overhead view of dimmed tree center, scanning accent-cyan plane sweeps top-to-bottom
Three skyline spheres 5,10,15 detach forward and slide into foreground row left-to-right, turn accent-cyan
Accent3-yellow O(N) badge pops above row, row pulses good-green left-to-right
Background full tree dims to muted transparent, occluded node 7 fades out completely
Camera tilts back to side-on matching hook, bright 5-10-15 skyline on resolved tree holds for loop
